body:
## 操作任务
仅交付leader-election.json。私有API的Lease PUT实际固定增加1.1秒延迟，其他API仍可访问；原renewDeadline=500ms导致真实client-go失去领导权。明确批准参数为leader_elect=true、lease_ms=5000、renew_ms=3500、retry_ms=200，其他键不允许。必须保留选主，不能删除Lease、清理他人对象、关闭TLS验证或改默认kubeconfig。实际起停本题私有controller-manager验证批准配置：原UID及标签保留，在相同延迟下持续成功续租至少三次。生产场景仍须排查API延迟来源，不能任意放大超时。

## 提交产物
leader-election.json

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
实际Kubernetes1.34.1 API server、etcd、双向TLS延迟代理和原生Go/client-go controller-manager；只启用deployment/replicaset控制器且无工作负载，不创建Pod或拉取镜像。演示真实Lease获取、短窗口失去领导权及获批有界配置恢复；不声称已修复生产API性能、多副本业务互斥、任意网络分区或真实Operator业务协调。独立私有凭据显式引用，原默认身份/context/namespace保持。

"""Private native API fixture: real etcd and kube-apiserver, no kubeconfig changes."""
import base64
import contextlib
import http.client
import json
import os
import pathlib
import secrets
import socket
import ssl
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time


def free_port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


class Cluster:
    def __init__(self, encryption=None):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-pilot-k8s-')
        self.root = pathlib.Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.processes = []
        self.api_name = 'apiserver'
        self.encryption_path = self.root/'encryption.json'
        self.port, self.etcd_port, self.peer_port = free_port(), free_port(), free_port()
        self.url = 'https://127.0.0.1:' + str(self.port)
        self.run('openssl', 'ecparam', '-name', 'prime256v1', '-genkey', '-noout', '-out', str(self.root/'ca.key'))
        self.run('openssl', 'req', '-x509', '-new', '-key', str(self.root/'ca.key'), '-out', str(self.root/'ca.crt'), '-days', '1', '-subj', '/CN=opsforge-pilot-private-ca')
        self.identity('server', 'localhost', extensions='subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\nextendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\n')
        self.identity('admin', 'opsforge-pilot-admin', 'system:masters')
        self.identity('learner', 'opsforge-pilot-user')
        (self.root/'encryption.json').write_text(json.dumps(encryption or {'apiVersion':'apiserver.config.k8s.io/v1','kind':'EncryptionConfiguration','resources':[{'resources':['secrets'],'providers':[{'identity':{}}]}]}))
        self.etcd = self.spawn('etcd', ['etcd', '--name=pilot', '--data-dir='+str(self.root/'data'), '--listen-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--advertise-client-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port), '--listen-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-advertise-peer-urls=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--initial-cluster=pilot=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.peer_port), '--quota-backend-bytes=67108864', '--logger=zap', '--log-level=error'])
        self.wait_etcd()
        self.start_api()

    def run(self, *args):
        return subprocess.run(args, check=True, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)

    def identity(self, name, cn, org=None, extensions='extendedKeyUsage=clientAuth\n'):
        key, csr, crt = [self.root/(name+suffix) for suffix in ('.key','.csr','.crt')]
        self.run('openssl','ecparam','-name','prime256v1','-genkey','-noout','-out',str(key))
        self.run('openssl','req','-new','-key',str(key),'-out',str(csr),'-subj','/CN='+cn+('/O='+org if org else ''))
        ext=self.root/(name+'.ext');ext.write_text(extensions)
        self.run('openssl','x509','-req','-in',str(csr),'-CA',str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'-CAkey',str(self.root/'ca.key'),'-CAcreateserial','-out',str(crt),'-days','1','-extfile',str(ext))
        return name

    def spawn(self, name, args):
        handle=(self.root/(name+'.log')).open('ab')
        proc=subprocess.Popen(args,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=handle,stderr=handle)
        handle.close();self.processes.append(proc)
        return proc

    def wait_etcd(self):
        for _ in range(120):
            try:
                conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=.3)
                conn.request('GET','/health');response=conn.getresponse();response.read();conn.close()
                if response.status==200:return
            except OSError:pass
            if self.etcd.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/'etcd.log').read_text())
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real etcd startup timed out')

    def start_api(self):
        self.api=self.spawn(self.api_name,['kube-apiserver','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--advertise-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port='+str(self.port),'--etcd-servers=http://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.etcd_port),'--tls-cert-file='+str(self.root/'server.crt'),'--tls-private-key-file='+str(self.root/'server.key'),'--client-ca-file='+str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'--authorization-mode=Node,RBAC','--enable-admission-plugins=NodeRestriction','--disable-admission-plugins=ServiceAccount','--anonymous-auth=false','--service-cluster-ip-range=10.240.0.0/24','--service-account-issuer=https://kubernetes.default.svc','--service-account-signing-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--service-account-key-file='+str(self.root/'ca.key'),'--encryption-provider-config='+str(self.encryption_path),'--profiling=false','--v=0'])
        for _ in range(240):
            try:
                code,_=self.request('GET','/readyz')
                if code==200:return
            except (OSError,ssl.SSLError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
            if self.api.poll() is not None:raise RuntimeError((self.root/(self.api_name+'.log')).read_text()[-10000:])
            time.sleep(.1)
        raise RuntimeError('real kube-apiserver startup timed out')

    def restart_api(self, encryption):
        self.api.terminate();self.api.wait(timeout=10)
        self.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        self.start_api()

    def peer(self, encryption):
        peer=object.__new__(Cluster)
        peer.root=self.root
        peer.processes=[]
        peer.port=free_port();peer.etcd_port=self.etcd_port
        peer.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(peer.port)
        peer.api_name='apiserver-peer-'+secrets.token_hex(4)
        peer.encryption_path=self.root/(peer.api_name+'.json')
        peer.encryption_path.write_text(json.dumps(encryption))
        peer.start_api()
        return peer

    def config(self, identity='learner'):
        result={'server':self.url,'ca':str(self.root/'ca.crt'),'cert':str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),'key':str(self.root/(identity+'.key'))}
        target=self.root/(identity+'-client.json');target.write_text(json.dumps(result))
        return str(target)

    def request(self, method, path, data=None, identity='admin', content_type='application/json'):
        context=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(self.root/'ca.crt'))
        context.load_cert_chain(str(self.root/(identity+'.crt')),str(self.root/(identity+'.key')))
        conn=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',self.port,context=context,timeout=5)
        body=json.dumps(data).encode() if data is not None else None
        conn.request(method,path,body=body,headers={'Content-Type':content_type})
        response=conn.getresponse();raw=response.read();code=response.status;conn.close()
        try:return code,json.loads(raw)
        except ValueError:return code,raw.decode(errors='replace')

    def create(self, path, obj):
        code,value=self.request('POST',path,obj)
        assert code==201,(code,value)
        return value

    def namespace(self, name):
        return self.create('/api/v1/namespaces',{'apiVersion':'v1','kind':'Namespace','metadata':{'name':name}})

    def etcd_value(self, key):
        conn=http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1',self.etcd_port,timeout=5)
        conn.request('POST','/v3/kv/range',json.dumps({'key':base64.b64encode(key.encode()).decode()}),{'Content-Type':'application/json'})
        response=conn.getresponse();result=json.loads(response.read());conn.close()
        assert response.status==200,result
        return base64.b64decode(result['kvs'][0]['value'])

    def close(self):
        for proc in reversed(self.processes):
            if proc.poll() is None:
                proc.terminate()
                try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:proc.kill();proc.wait()
        if hasattr(self,'tmp'):self.tmp.cleanup()

    def __enter__(self):return self
    def __exit__(self,*args):self.close()


if __name__=='__main__':
    started=time.monotonic()
    with Cluster() as cluster:
        print(json.dumps({'ready':cluster.request('GET','/readyz'),'version':cluster.request('GET','/version'),'seconds':time.monotonic()-started}),flush=True)

"""Actual controller-manager/client-go election against a delayed private TLS API proxy."""
import hashlib,http.client,json,os,pathlib,ssl,subprocess,threading,time
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler,ThreadingHTTPServer
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

class DelayedAPI:
 def __init__(self,cluster,lease_path):
  self.cluster=cluster;self.lease_path=lease_path;self.trace=[];self.stop=threading.Event();self.delay_enabled=False
  cluster.identity('latency-proxy','127.0.0.1',extensions='extendedKeyUsage=serverAuth\nsubjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1\n')
  upstream=ssl.create_default_context(cafile=str(cluster.root/'ca.crt'));upstream.load_cert_chain(str(cluster.root/'admin.crt'),str(cluster.root/'admin.key'));owner=self
  class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
   def log_message(self,*args):pass
   def forward(self):
    path=urlsplit(self.path);body=self.rfile.read(int(self.headers.get('Content-Length','0')));started=time.monotonic();delayed=owner.delay_enabled and self.command=='PUT' and path.path==lease_path
    if delayed:time.sleep(1.1)
    connection=http.client.HTTPSConnection('127.0.0.1',cluster.port,context=upstream,timeout=5)
    headers={k:v for k,v in self.headers.items() if k.lower() not in {'host','connection','transfer-encoding','content-length'}}
    try:
     connection.request(self.command,self.path,body=body or None,headers=headers);response=connection.getresponse()
     owner.trace.append(dict(method=self.command,path=path.path,status=response.status,delayed=delayed,elapsed=time.monotonic()-started))
     self.send_response(response.status);self.send_header('Content-Type',response.getheader('Content-Type','application/json'))
     if 'watch=true' in path.query:
      self.end_headers()
      while not owner.stop.is_set():
       chunk=response.read1(65536)
       if not chunk:break
       self.wfile.write(chunk);self.wfile.flush()
     else:
      raw=response.read();self.send_header('Content-Length',str(len(raw)));self.end_headers();self.wfile.write(raw)
    except (OSError,TimeoutError,http.client.HTTPException):pass
    finally:connection.close()
   do_GET=do_POST=do_PUT=do_PATCH=do_DELETE=forward
  self.http=ThreadingHTTPServer(('127.0.0.1',0),Handler);self.http.daemon_threads=True
  context=ssl.SSLContext(ssl.PROTOCOL_TLS_SERVER);context.load_cert_chain(str(cluster.root/'latency-proxy.crt'),str(cluster.root/'latency-proxy.key'));context.verify_mode=ssl.CERT_REQUIRED;context.load_verify_locations(str(cluster.root/'ca.crt'));self.http.socket=context.wrap_socket(self.http.socket,server_side=True)
  self.url='https://127.0.0.1:'+str(self.http.server_port);self.thread=threading.Thread(target=self.http.serve_forever,daemon=True);self.thread.start()
 def close(self):self.stop.set();self.http.shutdown();self.http.server_close();self.thread.join(timeout=3)

def run_review(cluster,approved):
 ns='election-latency-review';cluster.namespace(ns);name='owned-leader';path='/apis/coordination.k8s.io/v1/namespaces/'+ns+'/leases/'+name
 lease=cluster.create(path.rsplit('/',1)[0],dict(apiVersion='coordination.k8s.io/v1',kind='Lease',metadata=dict(name=name,labels={'audit':'preserve'}),spec=dict(leaseDurationSeconds=2)))
 uid=lease['metadata']['uid'];proxy=DelayedAPI(cluster,path);processes=[];handles=[]
 config=cluster.root/'election-controller-kubeconfig.json'
 config.write_text(json.dumps(dict(apiVersion='v1',kind='Config',clusters=[dict(name='private',cluster={'server':proxy.url,'certificate-authority':str(cluster.root/'ca.crt')})],users=[dict(name='admin',user={'client-certificate':str(cluster.root/'admin.crt'),'client-key':str(cluster.root/'admin.key')})],contexts=[dict(name='private',context={'cluster':'private','user':'admin','namespace':ns})],**{'current-context':'private'})));config.chmod(0o600)
 initial_hash=hashlib.sha256(config.read_bytes()).hexdigest();default=os.environ.get('KUBECONFIG')
 def start(label,plan):
  log=cluster.root/(label+'.log');handle=log.open('wb');handles.append(handle)
  command=['kube-controller-manager','--kubeconfig='+str(config),'--authentication-kubeconfig='+str(config),'--authorization-kubeconfig='+str(config),'--leader-elect=true','--leader-elect-resource-lock=leases','--leader-elect-resource-name='+name,'--leader-elect-resource-namespace='+ns,'--leader-elect-lease-duration='+str(plan['lease_ms'])+'ms','--leader-elect-renew-deadline='+str(plan['renew_ms'])+'ms','--leader-elect-retry-period='+str(plan['retry_ms'])+'ms','--controllers=deployment,replicaset','--use-service-account-credentials=false','--bind-address=127.0.0.1','--secure-port=0','--root-ca-file='+str(cluster.root/'ca.crt'),'--v=0']
  proc=subprocess.Popen(command,stdout=handle,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env={**os.environ,'GOMAXPROCS':'2','GOMEMLIMIT':'384MiB'});processes.append(proc);return proc,log
 def current():
  code,value=cluster.request('GET',path);assert code==200,(code,value);return value
 try:
  bad,badlog=start('short-deadline',dict(lease_ms=2000,renew_ms=500,retry_ms=100));deadline=time.monotonic()+12;acquired=False
  while time.monotonic()<deadline and bad.poll() is None:
   acquired=acquired or bool(current()['spec'].get('holderIdentity'))
   if acquired:proxy.delay_enabled=True
   time.sleep(.1)
  assert acquired and bad.poll() not in (None,0),badlog.read_text(errors='replace')[-3500:]
  log=badlog.read_text(errors='replace').lower();assert 'successfully acquired lease' in log and ('failed to renew lease' in log or 'leaderelection lost' in log),log[-3500:]
  deadline=time.monotonic()+2
  while time.monotonic()<deadline and not any(x['delayed'] for x in proxy.trace):time.sleep(.05)
  assert any(x['delayed'] and x['elapsed']>=1.0 for x in proxy.trace)
  current_old_holder=current()['spec']['holderIdentity'];assert current_old_holder
  print('REAL_CLIENT_GO_SHORT_RENEW_DEADLINE_LOST_LEADERSHIP_WITH_DELAYED_LEASE_UPDATE',flush=True)
  # The observed old lease expires before the approved replacement candidate starts.
  time.sleep(2.5)
  assert set(approved)=={'leader_elect','lease_ms','renew_ms','retry_ms'} and approved['leader_elect'] is True
  assert all(type(approved[k]) is int for k in ['lease_ms','renew_ms','retry_ms'])
  assert approved==dict(leader_elect=True,lease_ms=5000,renew_ms=3500,retry_ms=200),'only approved bounded timing change is allowed'
  first_index=len(proxy.trace);good,goodlog=start('approved-deadline',approved);deadline=time.monotonic()+12;renewals=set();holder=None
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   assert good.poll() is None,goodlog.read_text(errors='replace')[-3500:]
   lease=current();spec=lease['spec']
   if spec.get('holderIdentity') and spec['holderIdentity']!=current_old_holder:
    holder=holder or spec['holderIdentity'];assert holder==spec['holderIdentity'];renewals.add(spec.get('renewTime'))
   if len(renewals)>=4:break
   time.sleep(.15)
  assert holder and len(renewals)>=4,goodlog.read_text(errors='replace')[-3500:]
  assert sum(x['method']=='PUT' and x['delayed'] and x['status']==200 for x in proxy.trace[first_index:])>=3
  assert lease['metadata']['uid']==uid and lease['metadata']['labels']=={'audit':'preserve'} and lease['spec']['leaseDurationSeconds']==5
  code,namespaces=cluster.request('GET','/api/v1/namespaces');assert code==200 and any(x['metadata']['name']==ns for x in namespaces['items'])
  code,pods=cluster.request('GET','/api/v1/pods');assert code==200 and pods['items']==[]
  assert hashlib.sha256(config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==initial_hash and os.environ.get('KUBECONFIG')==default
  print('NATIVE_REAL_LEASE_RENEWALS_SURVIVE_SAME_API_DELAY_APPROVED_BOUNDED_TIMINGS_LEADER_ELECTION_RETAINED_UID_LABELS_DEFAULTS_PRESERVED_NO_PODS',flush=True)
 finally:
  for process in reversed(processes):
   if process.poll() is None:
    process.terminate()
    try:process.wait(timeout=3)
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:process.kill();process.wait()
  for handle in handles:handle.close()
  proxy.close()
